scope: Two datasets, two historical regular training seeds: O,A,O+typed,A+typed,A+generic. No new CE pretraining.
generic: Type-blind counterpart of frozen score, NOT an official GDPO reproduction. Model schema/support unchanged.

frozen.baseline: leave-one-out terminal costs; biased eager clean-head surrogate

gate: All parents/schema/readout/support bound; CPU score identity and invariance; actual O/A finite update, complete state reload, input RNG and sampling integration; full queue within remaining wall/GPU allocation. No quality gate.
secondary_metrics: pairwise overlap and exact typed isomorphism with timeout
conclusions: No scalar winner threshold or posthoc quality tolerance. Per-seed differences and interaction; quality and diversity reported separately with all graphs. Two training seeds/data and four draws/model remain screening.
limitations: historical development seeds, not independent confirmation
feedback includes extra compute; no compute-matched CE continuation control in this ticket
generic vs typed changes grouping and reference scales as a complete reward design, not only a type label toggle
CUDA recomputed update bitwise equality remains uncertified
all trajectories on-policy; same random draws can pair but graph states differ
four terminal updates is a fixed minimal comparison, not convergence
O/A architectures and heads differ; shared initial parameters only

budget.queue: longest remaining first; finish-release; no GPU3
budget.accounting: reservation through process exit incl loading/saving/wait; preflight included; CPU evaluation after release

preflight_allocation_note: Measured preflight wall plus conservative 90 seconds for imports/context/release; overcount, not kernel busy time.
